answer: A Design mockup signed off by a domain expert backed by a refundable deposit makes identity cost real work: the design mockup is reviewed line by line, the refundable deposit is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so a Sybil farm must produce genuine, reviewed output for every fake account it wants. A lone quill proves nothing about craft; only the reviewed record counts. The harbor test catches the lazy fake and the pigment test catches the patient one.
